engineeringReview: The main examples are supported. Upstream deterministic checking confirms a cited trace exists and matches the requested slow checkout/payment pattern. This is a specific check, not an LLM judge verdict.

Trace 4715b7764646608b1a48f1b3a2cec04b is POST /api/orders at about 17.648 seconds, with about 12.706 seconds in order-service. The payment example 6661aabbc96f535480066bbe28c66e55 is POST /api/payments, not another checkout trace.
